## Findings

**File Path:** C:\Users\x8120\AppData\Local\Temp\mokaair-claude-case-8a4fwl10\

### Critical Logic Inversion Issue

**File:** model.js, line 7 vs. fixtures/toggle.diff, line 6

**Current Implementation (Correct):**
```javascript
return items.map(item => item.id === id ? { ...item, completed: !item.completed } : item);
```

**Diff Proposes (Incorrect):**
```javascript
return items.map(item => item.id !== id ? { ...item, completed: !item.completed } : item);
```

**Trigger Condition:** Calling `toggleTodo(items, id)` to toggle the completion status of a single item

**The Logic Error:**
The diff inverts the ternary condition from `item.id === id` to `item.id !== id`. This reverses the intended behavior:

- **Current logic:** Toggles the item that MATCHES the provided id, leaves others unchanged
- **Diff's logic:** Would toggle all items that DON'T match the id, leaves the target item unchanged

**Concrete Test Case (from tests/model.test.mjs, lines 16-22):**
```
Input: original = [
  { id: 'a', title: '相同標題', completed: false },
  { id: 'b', title: '相同標題', completed: true }
]
Call: toggleTodo(original, 'a')

Expected behavior:
- Item 'a': false → true (toggled) ✓
- Item 'b': true → true (unchanged) ✓

With diff's logic, would produce:
- Item 'a': false → false (unchanged) ✗
- Item 'b': true → false (toggled) ✗
```

**Test Verification Status:** The test "依照識別碼切換指定項目，不改動其他項目" (lines 16-22) will FAIL if the diff is applied. The assertion on line 19 expects `updated[0].completed` to be `true`, but the inverted logic would leave it `false`.
